title: Bauhaus School of Architecture Modernist Build
author: jduartemiller

generated.description: A large modernist school of architecture in the Bauhaus style, built mostly from white and light gray wool, quartz slabs, glass, and black wool accents, with a stone base and a few oak and acacia trees around it. It measures about 118 blocks wide, 28 high, and 141 deep, and it sits on a grassy, dirt-based plot with a flat roofline and a tall block tower on one side. The interior is mostly unfinished from the data, with a few bookshelves, an oak door, and a couple of flower pots and furnaces as block entities.
